parameters.content:
## B · User–loan matching
Triggered by the ingest Lambda through an HMAC-signed webhook.

**Funnel** — every stage only sees what the previous one could not decide:
1. **SQL hard filter** checks income, CIBIL, age and employment for every user × product in one statement.
   Products with no qualitative criteria are matched right here.
2. The rest collapse into **profile classes** (employment × income band × CIBIL band × age band).
3. **Cache** — verdicts are keyed by product version and class, so repeat profiles cost nothing.
4. **LLM** judges only uncached classes, 20 per call, then verdicts fan back out to users.

parameters.query:
with started as (
    update upload_batches
    set status = 'matching', execution_id = $2, error = null, updated_at = now()
    where batch_id = $1::uuid
      and status in ('ingested', 'matched', 'done', 'failed')
    returning batch_id
),
stale_matches as (
    delete from matches m
    using users u
    where u.batch_id in (select batch_id from started)
      and m.user_id = u.user_id
      and m.notified_at is null
),
stale_candidates as (
    delete from match_candidates
    where batch_id in (select batch_id from started)
)
select batch_id, clock_timestamp() as started_at
from started

with batch_users as (
    select *
    from users
    where batch_id = $1::uuid
),
products as (
    select p.*,
           coalesce(p.interest_rate_min,
                    (select min(q.interest_rate_min)
                       from loan_products q
                      where q.lender = p.lender
                        and q.is_active)) as best_rate
    from loan_products p
    where p.is_active and p.is_matchable
),
passing as (
    select u.user_id,
           p.product_id,
           p.qualitative_criteria,
           format('%s|inc%s|cs%s|age%s',
                  u.employment_status,
                  (u.monthly_income / 25000) * 25,
                  (u.credit_score / 50) * 50,
                  (u.age / 5) * 5) as class_key,
           round(
               0.5 * case when p.best_rate is null then 0.5 else least(greatest((24 - p.best_rate) / 14, 0), 1) end
               + 0.25 * least(greatest((u.credit_score - coalesce(p.min_credit_score, 650)) / 100.0, 0), 1)
               + 0.25 * least(u.monthly_income / (3.0 * coalesce(p.min_monthly_income, 25000)), 1),
               3
           ) as score,
           concat_ws(' · ',
               case when p.min_monthly_income is not null then
                   format('Income ₹%s meets the ₹%s minimum',
                          trim(to_char(u.monthly_income, '99,99,99,999')),
                          trim(to_char(p.min_monthly_income, '99,99,99,999')))
               end,
               case when p.min_credit_score is not null then
                   format('CIBIL %s clears %s', u.credit_score, p.min_credit_score)
               end,
               case when p.min_age is not null or p.max_age is not null then
                   format('Age %s within %s–%s', u.age, coalesce(p.min_age, 18), coalesce(p.max_age, 100))
               end,
               case when cardinality(p.employment_types) > 0 then
                   format('%s applicants accepted', initcap(replace(u.employment_status, '_', '-')))
               end,
               case when p.best_rate is not null then
                   format('Rates from %s%% p.a.', p.best_rate)
               end
           ) as reason
    from batch_users u
    join products p
      on (p.min_monthly_income is null or u.monthly_income >= p.min_monthly_income)
     and (p.min_credit_score is null or u.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score)
     and (p.max_credit_score is null or u.credit_score <= p.max_credit_score)
     and (p.min_age is null or u.age >= p.min_age)
     and (p.max_age is null or u.age <= p.max_age)
     and (coalesce(cardinality(p.employment_types), 0) = 0 or u.employment_status = any (p.employment_types))
),
direct as (
    insert into matches (user_id, product_id, batch_id, stage, verdict, score, reason)
    select user_id, product_id, $1::uuid, 'sql', 'eligible', score, reason
    from passing
    where qualitative_criteria is null
    on conflict (user_id, product_id) do update set
        batch_id = excluded.batch_id,
        stage = excluded.stage,
        verdict = excluded.verdict,
        score = excluded.score,
        reason = excluded.reason,
        created_at = now(),
        notified_at = case when matches.batch_id = excluded.batch_id then matches.notified_at end
    returning 1
),
deferred as (
    insert into match_candidates (batch_id, user_id, product_id, class_key, score, reason)
    select $1::uuid, user_id, product_id, class_key, score, reason
    from passing
    where qualitative_criteria is not null
    returning 1
)
select (select count(*) from batch_users)::int as users_in_batch,
       (select count(*) from products)::int as products_active,
       ((select count(*) from batch_users) * (select count(*) from products))::int as pairs_total,
       (select count(*) from passing)::int as pairs_after_sql,
       (select count(*) from direct)::int as sql_matches,
       (select count(*) from deferred)::int as pairs_deferred

select c.product_id,
       p.version as product_version,
       p.lender,
       p.product_name,
       p.qualitative_criteria,
       c.class_key,
       count(*)::int as users,
       e.verdict as cached_verdict
from match_candidates c
join loan_products p on p.product_id = c.product_id
left join llm_eval_cache e
       on e.product_id = c.product_id
      and e.product_version = p.version
      and e.class_key = c.class_key
where c.batch_id = $1::uuid
group by c.product_id, p.version, p.lender, p.product_name, p.qualitative_criteria, c.class_key, e.verdict
order by c.product_id, c.class_key

insert into llm_eval_cache (product_id, product_version, class_key, verdict, reason)
select product_id, product_version, class_key, verdict, reason
from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as v (
    product_id integer,
    product_version integer,
    class_key text,
    verdict text,
    reason text
)
on conflict (product_id, product_version, class_key) do nothing
returning 1

with fanned as (
    insert into matches (user_id, product_id, batch_id, stage, verdict, score, reason)
    select c.user_id,
           c.product_id,
           c.batch_id,
           case when e.created_at < $2::timestamptz then 'cache' else 'llm' end,
           e.verdict,
           round(c.score * case when e.verdict = 'likely' then 0.85 else 1 end, 3),
           c.reason || ' · ' || e.reason
    from match_candidates c
    join loan_products p on p.product_id = c.product_id
    join llm_eval_cache e
      on e.product_id = c.product_id
     and e.product_version = p.version
     and e.class_key = c.class_key
    where c.batch_id = $1::uuid
      and e.verdict <> 'ineligible'
    on conflict (user_id, product_id) do update set
        batch_id = excluded.batch_id,
        stage = excluded.stage,
        verdict = excluded.verdict,
        score = excluded.score,
        reason = excluded.reason,
        created_at = now(),
        notified_at = case when matches.batch_id = excluded.batch_id then matches.notified_at end
    returning 1
),
cleared as (
    delete from match_candidates
    where batch_id = $1::uuid
),
recorded as (
    insert into match_runs (
        batch_id, users_in_batch, products_active, pairs_total, pairs_after_sql, sql_matches, pairs_deferred,
        classes_to_judge, cache_hits, llm_calls, llm_matches, total_matches, duration_ms
    )
    select $1::uuid,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'users_in_batch')::int,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'products_active')::int,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'pairs_total')::int,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'pairs_after_sql')::int,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'sql_matches')::int,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'pairs_deferred')::int,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'classes_to_judge')::int,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'cache_hits')::int,
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'llm_calls')::int,
           (select count(*) from fanned),
           ($3::jsonb ->> 'sql_matches')::int + (select count(*) from fanned),
           (extract(epoch from clock_timestamp() - $2::timestamptz) * 1000)::int
    on conflict (batch_id) do update set
        users_in_batch = excluded.users_in_batch,
        products_active = excluded.products_active,
        pairs_total = excluded.pairs_total,
        pairs_after_sql = excluded.pairs_after_sql,
        sql_matches = excluded.sql_matches,
        pairs_deferred = excluded.pairs_deferred,
        classes_to_judge = excluded.classes_to_judge,
        cache_hits = excluded.cache_hits,
        llm_calls = excluded.llm_calls,
        llm_matches = excluded.llm_matches,
        total_matches = excluded.total_matches,
        duration_ms = excluded.duration_ms,
        created_at = now()
    returning total_matches
)
update upload_batches
set status = 'matched', updated_at = now()
where batch_id = $1::uuid
returning batch_id, (select total_matches from recorded) as total_matches

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Start matching').first().json.batch_id, $('Start matching').first().json.started_at, JSON.stringify({ ...$('SQL hard filter').first().json, ...$('Plan LLM calls').first().json.stats })] }}
